}}'''Ramey''' is the head groom at the [[The Queen's Blessing]] in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ramey}}

==Appearance==
He is leathery-skinned and horse-faced.

==Activities==
When [[Rand]] and the others leave the Queen's Blessing for the Ways, Ramey makes sure the alley behind the stables is clear.{{ref/book|1|44}}

When [[Mat]] comes to [[Caemlyn]] to deliver a letter to [[Morgase Trakand]] from [[Elayne Trakand]], Ramey stables Mat's horse.{{ref/book|3|45}}
